source.title: National Insurance Institute, child savings: savings amount page (effective 01.01.2026)

monthly_deposit.notes: NIS 58 a month per child in 2026, paid by the National Insurance Institute on the 20th. Updated each 1 January by the CPI rise (reg. 12); the update was skipped on 1 January 2025 (law s.74ה(4)), when the amount stayed at the 2024 level (NIS 57). NIS 50 at the 2017 start. Law 74ב(א)(1) bracket also reads 'בשנת 2026, 58 ש״ח'.
